content: A washed up edgerunner & a killer netrunner in Night City... what could go wrong? A new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives October 20th, only on Netflix. TRAILER MUSIC “A Rusty Dream” — written, performed, composed, and arranged by DOUDOU (Du Binger / Du Feier), produced by DOUDOU (Du Binger / Du Feier) & Yuyunhsieh, recorded, mixed and mastered by Yuyunhsieh Project Coordinator: Lucian Ma, Overall Coordinator: Modern Sky / Modern Sky Game House, Executive Producer: Meow Miu and Production Company: Pollux Music VHS Filter by: YUICHIROH TOZAWA (GRAPHINICA) Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81744227 About Netflix: Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 | Official Teaser #3 | Netflix https://www.youtube.com/@Netflix
chineseContent: 夜之城中一个被淘汰的边缘跑者和一个杀手网络跑者……会出什么问题吗？来自《赛博朋克 2077》世界的全新 10 集独立故事《赛博朋克：Edgerunners 2》将于 10 月 20 日登陆 Netflix。预告片音乐《生锈的梦》 — 由 DOUDOU（杜冰儿 / 杜飞儿）作词、演奏、作曲和编曲，由 DOUDOU（杜冰儿 / 杜飞儿）和 Yuyunhsieh 制作，Yuyunhsieh 录制、混音和母带 项目协调人：Lucian Ma，总协调人：摩登天空 / 摩登天空游戏屋，执行制作人：Meow Miu 制作公司：Pollux Music VHS户泽雄一郎 (GRAPHINICA) 在 Netflix 上观看：https://www.netflix.com/title/81744227 关于 Netflix：Netflix 是世界领先的娱乐服务公司之一，提供多种类型和语言的电视剧、电影、游戏和现场节目。会员可以随时随地随意播放、暂停和继续观看，并且可以随时更改计划。赛博朋克：Edgerunners 2 |官方预告#3 | Netflix https://www.youtube.com/@Netflix
